prompt:
Create ENV-01 / Nature, Ground and Equipment, a STATIC game asset master board for the same Civilization Town / Living Settlement project. Reuse the material and camera language visible in WORLD-01 and BLDG-01. This is an illustrated asset library, not a web dashboard.

PLATFORM: Desktop art review.

STRUCTURE AND REQUIRED CONTENT:
1. Compact board heading and static-only classification.
2. One original isolated nature master sheet with five clearly separated groups: tree, bush, rock, grass clump, crop. Show three silhouette variants for tree/bush/rock, two grass clumps and two crop patches (grain and leafy vegetables). Trees have visible connected trunks/roots; rock forms have clean planes; crops have connected stems. Place IDs outside the illustration.
3. Ground material reference section with three separate texture images for terrain_grass, terrain_dirt and terrain_path. These will eventually target 32x32 pixels. Show each master and a 3x3 repetition preview so seams can be inspected. Add two secondary appearance swatches, water and concrete, to cover existing grid types. These are static textures; no ripples or flowing animation. Do not claim a seamless production tile unless the actual repeated image proves it.
4. One original equipment/props master sheet containing exactly eleven separate items in a generously spaced 3x4 matrix (one unused slot): hoe, watering_can, axe, hammer, pickaxe, book, writing_tool, carried_stone, timber, log_stack, crate. Consistent scale per category; all silhouettes complete. A hoe has ONE blade at one end and an ordinary wooden grip at the other, not two fork heads. Watering can has a complete handle and spout; axe/pickaxe/hammer heads are attached to their shafts; crate and log stack remain distinct objects. Do not embed captions inside item art.
5. Short legend with asset IDs, intended game-size notes and honest alpha/seam verification status.

IMAGE / EXPORT REQUIREMENTS:
- Generate real original illustrated pixel-art image assets downloadable separately. Do not replace illustrations with emoji, Material Symbols, stock photos or CSS rectangles.
- Keep every object isolated with uniform empty background when transparency is unavailable; no textured paper behind cutouts, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no intersecting objects.
- Favor small-size readable shapes over decorative microdetail. No glitter, particle effects, soft blurry raster edges or realistic photographic textures.
- All content static; no GIF, no animation, no motion CSS.
- Use the existing Living Settlement project design system.

screens.title:
Authentic 16-bit pixel-art terrain and ground material reference board on a completely flat, solid uniform parchment beige background (#E7DABC). Crisp 16-bit retro isometric strategy game pixel art. No baked text inside the swatches.

Layout showing three primary ground terrain textures plus two secondary swatches, each displaying the single master swatch tile beside an unbordered 3x3 repetition preview grid:
1. terrain_grass: Master swatch and 3x3 tiled inspection block. Muted organic field grass texture (#93AF75 base, #78965C shadow, subtle mossy flecks).
2. terrain_dirt: Master swatch and 3x3 tiled inspection block. Tilled rich loam soil texture (#B28E65, #96734F shadow, tiny fine gravel flecks).
3. terrain_path: Master swatch and 3x3 tiled inspection block. Compacted village walking trail loam and crushed river stone path texture (#C7AA7B).
4. Secondary Swatch A - water: Still shallow settlement canal / stream pond water (muted clear cyan-slate #527B8C and #8DB9BE, flat static crystal surface, no animated ripples).
5. Secondary Swatch B - concrete / hewn limestone: Ancient chiseled mortar flagstone masonry pavement (#919B8B, #BEC5AE).

Clean pixel art craft, strict static textures, crisp pixel grid, high readability. Solid #E7DABC canvas surrounding the swatches.

screens.title:
Authentic 16-bit isometric pixel-art nature asset master sheet: "ENV-01 Nature & Vegetation Master Matrix" on a solid, completely flat, uniform parchment beige background (#E7DABC) with generous empty space separating every group and item. Crisp pixel clusters, dark plum (#302C36) 1-pixel contour outline, upper-right light source, restrained 2-3 shade steps, strictly no text baked into artwork, no 3D rendering, no blur, no motion effects, completely static.

Five distinct isolated groups arranged cleanly:
1. Trees (3 distinct silhouette variants):
   - Variant A: Oak canopy tree with dense rounded foliage clumps (#59845A, #385C46) and sturdy visible oak trunk and grounded root flare (#65483C).
   - Variant B: Tall upright tapered cedar/elm tree with tiered foliage masses and strong straight timber trunk.
   - Variant C: Spreading orchard/birch tree with asymmetrical branching canopy and visible textured trunk base.
2. Bushes (3 distinct silhouette variants):
   - Variant A: Low dense flowering berry shrub cluster.
   - Variant B: Sprawling hedgerow bramble bush.
   - Variant C: Compact rounded manicured garden bush.
3. Rocks (3 distinct silhouette variants):
   - Variant A: Stepped mossy limestone boulder cluster with crisp chiseled facet planes (#919B8B, #687574).
   - Variant B: Low flat angular flagstone rock outcropping.
   - Variant C: Upright weathered quarry monolith stone.
4. Grass clumps (2 distinct variants):
   - Variant A: Small wild meadow grass tuft cluster (#93AF75).
   - Variant B: Tall reed/cattail grass clump with subtle seeds.
5. Crop patches (2 distinct variants):
   - Variant A: Golden harvest wheat patch with individual upright grain stalks and connected stems (#C2A05B).
   - Variant B: Leafy green turnip/cabbage garden crop patch in dark loam soil furrow (#AD644D soil, #59845A leaves, purple beet tops).

All items isolated, non-overlapping, with clear space for sprite cutting. Uniform #E7DABC background throughout.

screens.title:
Authentic 16-bit isometric pixel art equipment and prop master sheet: "ENV-01 Equipment & Settlement Props (3x4 Matrix)" on a solid, clean, completely flat uniform parchment beige background (#E7DABC). Crisp pixel clusters, dark plum outline (#302C36), upper-right sunlight direction, restrained 2-3 shade steps, zero baked typography/text inside the artwork.

Arranged in a clean, spacious 3 rows by 4 columns grid (11 distinct items, bottom right slot left completely empty):
Row 1:
1. hoe: Traditional single-ended farming draw-hoe. Sturdy straight wooden handle grip at one end, exactly ONE angled forged iron blade at the working head end (strictly one blade, not double-forked).
2. watering_can: Ancient beaten copper/terracotta garden watering can with continuous arched top carrying handle, sturdy side pour spout, and rounded body.
3. axe: Woodcutter felling axe with curved hickory wood handle and securely wedged iron cutting blade head.
4. hammer: Heavy joiner/stonemason mallet hammer with wrapped leather grip and solid rectangular iron/stone head firmly attached.

Row 2:
5. pickaxe: Miner pickaxe with tapered ash wood haft and dual-pointed forged iron pick head.
6. book: Ancient bound scholar folio book with brass corner brackets, leather spine, and fastened latch.
7. writing_tool: Reed scribe stylus and goose quill paired with a small ceramic dark inkpot.
8. carried_stone: Square chisel-hewn limestone building block with beveled edges and rough surface texture.

Row 3:
9. timber: Squared-off oak construction timber beam log with visible end-grain rings.
10. log_stack: Neatly pyramid-stacked pile of rustic round peeled oak firewood logs secured with timber stakes.
11. crate: Reinforced slatted wooden shipping crate with cross-bracing and iron corner brackets.
(Slot 12 is cleanly empty with clear spacing).

All items fully isolated with generous breathing room, anatomically intact tool construction, matching the Living Settlement 28-color palette. Flat #E7DABC background throughout.
